packageRules.description: Group low-risk dev tooling into a single PR to keep review volume manageable.

R3 — ink and react majors drag the whole TUI with them. The upstream project never made that jump and this fork has thin TUI test coverage, so a major here is a deliberate project, not a routine bump. Renovate must not open these.
The OpenAI SDK is the primary integration surface; keep its majors separate and clearly labelled so they get a dedicated review.
Runtime dependencies ship to users — never auto-merge, always review.
